fusions.name: Trample Round
fusions.desc: Circles you on pounding hooves, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Ridden Down
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away and deals 15 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Short of Breath
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 60% for 15 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Another Lap Left
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 20 stamina. Once every 30 seconds.
